source_snapshot.items: GPU times sync with BMC time
source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC Web compare GPU Management Event Logs timestamps with BMC Date and Time.
source_snapshot.criteria: GPU log timestamps on BMC Web match BMC time.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; combines Redfish/D-Bus timestamps and BMC Web visual cross-check but leaves event identity, time base and tolerance undefined.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/LOW; requires same-target GPU mapping, stable event IDs, UTC/offset normalization, precision/skew/freshness and GUI/API evidence.

old_problem: An old event timestamp should not numerically equal current BMC time, and rendered strings may hide timezone or precision differences. Event identity, occurrence-versus-ingestion semantics, API-to-GUI mapping and acceptable skew were missing but can be parameterized.
disposition_reason: The read-only comparison method is clear. ED-06/15/20 allow GPU identity, vendor event-time semantics, sample freshness and maximum skew as project configuration. Stable event IDs, bounded retrieval timestamps, UTC normalization and matching WebUI rows make the result deterministic without setting clocks, injecting GPU faults or clearing logs.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2238, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2239 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00021-V001 / 7c6d220f0574df2e was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Bind BMC/SUT and exact GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF plus firmware before selecting events.
Record BMC timezone, UTC offset/DST, NTP/sync status, clock precision and retrieval time without changing them.
Select existing stable GPU event IDs whose occurrence or BMC-ingestion semantics and freshness are documented; no fault/event injection is implied.
Collect complete raw API/D-Bus records and current BMC clock in a bounded interval, then capture the same event rows and Date/Time page in BMC Web.
Normalize all values to UTC at declared precision and calculate per-event skew against the correct occurrence/ingestion reference; never compare old event time directly to current clock.
Treat missing offset, stale/duplicate/ambiguous event or API-GUI mismatch as explicit discrepancy; do not clear logs or set clock/NTP.
No login, API/GUI read, time change, event injection, log clear, retry or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: GPU event timestamps correlated to BMC clock time base
test_case.purpose: Verify that GPU events shown in BMC Web use the same documented authoritative time base as BMC Date and Time, within approved timezone, precision, freshness and skew rules.
required_package: Canonical GPU event resource, stable record-ID-to-WebUI-row mapping and occurrence/ingestion semantics
BMC timezone/UTC/DST/NTP/precision rules, sample freshness and maximum skew
Protected API/WebUI access and real GUI capture
test_case.test_command: Read BMC time/synchronization metadata and selected stable GPU event records in one bounded interval, record retrieval timestamps, map the same IDs to BMC Web GPU Event Logs, capture the Date/Time page, normalize event/reference values to UTC at approved precision, and calculate skew/freshness without modifying clocks or logs.
test_case.expected_result: Every selected GPU event maps to the same GUI/API record and its documented occurrence/ingestion timestamp reconciles with the BMC authoritative time base within the signed skew and precision tolerance; WebUI rendering matches the normalized values.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact GPU/event identity, documented time-field semantics, UTC/offset normalization, bounded retrieval/freshness, measured skew within threshold and real GUI/API reconciliation. Similar formatted strings, old-event versus current-clock equality or missing offsets cannot pass. Missing semantics/tolerance blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Verify same BMC/GPU/event IDs and approved time semantics before comparison.
Read-only only; no clock/NTP change, event/fault injection, log clear or service restart.
Stop on ambiguous/stale/duplicate records, missing offset, excessive retrieval delay or API-GUI mismatch.
expected_evidence: BMC timezone/offset/DST/NTP/precision, raw current time and retrieval timestamp
Complete selected raw GPU event IDs/timestamps/semantics and retrieval times
Timestamped WebUI event rows and Date/Time evidence
UTC-normalized values, per-event skew/freshness/tolerance calculations and API-GUI reconciliation
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected. On mapping or timing ambiguity, preserve raw and visual evidence and stop; do not set the clock, generate faults or clear/recreate events.

source_conflict.reason: The row coherently requires GPU event timestamps to share the BMC time basis; exact semantics/tolerance are runtime inputs.

blocked.reason: The read-only comparison is well defined once vendor event semantics and tolerance are supplied.

pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS PARAMETERIZED HYBRID TIME-CORRELATION TEST; REAL WEBUI EVIDENCE REQUIRED; NO LOGIN, READ, TIME CHANGE, EVENT INJECTION, LOG CLEAR, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.application: Requires real GUI evidence and explicit time semantics/tolerance rather than string-only comparison.
